description.value: The Dutch Bakery & Diner is a beloved Victoria institution on Fort Street, now celebrating 70 years of operation under three generations of the Dutch-immigrant Schaddelee family. The diner serves all-day breakfast and lunch including Dutch specialties like croquettes, burgers, omelettes, and salads, alongside an extensive selection of house-made pastries, cakes, cookies, and chocolates from the bakery counter. It's a characterful, old-fashioned stop in the heart of downtown Victoria with a loyal following and a long-tenured staff.
